Title: Data Analyst
Industry: Hospitals and Health Care and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description: About The Role  As our Data Analyst, you will support the development and evaluation of data driven health services in the ACT region. This will be achieved through increased data sharing and enhanced health intelligence with relevant stakeholders including CHN program staff, ACT Health and other Primary Health Networks. The successful applicant will be responsible for analysing complex health datasets to address areas of needs in our population health planning, service commissioning and business development.    CHN’s Data and Reporting Team sits under the Performance and Planning business unit, and provides key advice to inform the organisation’s reporting, planning and evaluation processes. This advice is used to support ACT service planning and commissioning processes, as well as program evaluation to integrate health care, improve health equity and achieve better health outcomes for Canberrans.    Your proficiency in data transformation, analysis and reporting will be crucial to optimise our data processes. You will thrive in using your ETL expertise to extract data from various sources, transform it into usable formats and load it within Azure cloud environments. Beyond this, your knowledge of secure data sharing mechanisms will see you play a key role in protecting CHN’s data assets while enabling collaboration to increase our overall data capability. You will work with a dynamic team of subject matter experts who share your passion in leveraging data to improve health outcomes and provide guidance and leadership in understanding local health and service needs.  As part of an innovative organisation, your work within the Data and Reporting Team will give you the opportunity to contribute to process improvement and broader organisational projects and initiatives.    This position is based in our newly renovated and modern office, located in the heart of the Belconnen town centre. We support flexibility and a hybrid work model at CHN and are happy to work with the successful candidate to ensure balance between work and life.    At CHN you will have an opportunity to work with professional subject matter experts and experienced leaders who encourage and support you to develop your interests, expertise and achieve your ambitions. Description: About The Role  As our Data Analyst, you will support the development and evaluation of data driven health services in the ACT region. This will be achieved through increased data sharing and enhanced health intelligence with relevant stakeholders including CHN program staff, ACT Health and other Primary Health Networks. The successful applicant will be responsible for analysing complex health datasets to address areas of needs in our population health planning, service commissioning and business development. You will work with a dynamic team of subject matter experts who share your passion in leveraging data to improve health outcomes and provide guidance and leadership in understanding local health and service needs.  As part of an innovative organisation, your work within the Data and Reporting Team will give you the opportunity to contribute to process improvement and broader organisational projects and initiatives.    This position is based in our newly renovated and modern office, located in the heart of the Belconnen town centre. You will thrive in using your ETL expertise to extract data from various sources, transform it into usable formats and load it within Azure cloud environments. You will work with a dynamic team of subject matter experts who share your passion in leveraging data to improve health outcomes and provide guidance and leadership in understanding local health and service needs.  As part of an innovative organisation, your work within the Data and Reporting Team will give you the opportunity to contribute to process improvement and broader organisational projects and initiatives.    This position is based in our newly renovated and modern office, located in the heart of the Belconnen town centre. We support flexibility and a hybrid work model at CHN and are happy to work with the successful candidate to ensure balance between work and life. Title: Senior Pricing Analyst - APAC
State: Macquarie Park, New South Wales, Australia
Industry: Biotechnology Research, Medical Equipment Manufacturing, and Research Services
Description: We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose  BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.    Can you see the commercial story behind the numbers and turn it into a pricing strategy that drives profitable growth?  This is not a role for someone who simply reports the data.  We're looking for a commercially minded analyst who can interrogate the numbers, challenge assumptions and partner with business leaders to uncover where pricing, product mix and commercial decisions can drive stronger performance.  Working across a diverse APAC region, you'll help bring greater consistency and discipline to pricing while recognising that what works in Australia may not work in Korea, India or Southeast Asia. The challenge, and the opportunity, is finding the right balance between regional best practice and local market reality.    As our , you'll become a trusted commercial partner to regional and country leadership, using data and insight to influence pricing strategy, tenders, contracts and ultimately, profitable growth.  You'll analyse price, volume, product mix and gross profit, identify opportunities and help leaders understand not only what the numbers are telling us, but what we should do about it.  This is an opportunity to help shape how pricing is approached across the region, creating stronger frameworks and best practices while working within the commercial nuances of some very different and dynamic healthcare markets.  Your Day-to-Day  Your role will sit at the intersection of data, pricing and commercial strategy.  One day you could be analysing the profitability of a major tender or contract. The next, you might be partnering with a country leader to understand the impact of price, volume and product mix, identifying opportunities to improve margin or developing a regional approach that brings greater consistency to pricing decisions.        You're analytical, but you're not someone who wants to sit behind a spreadsheet all day.  You're curious about the business behind the numbers.  When you see margin move, you want to understand why. Was it price? Volume? Product mix? Customer behaviour? Market conditions? And, most importantly, what can we do differently?  You're comfortable sitting with senior stakeholders, telling the story behind the data and constructively challenging the business when the numbers point to a different answer.      Why BD?  BD is one of the world's largest medical technology companies, but we've never lost our human touch.  With more than 70,000 associates worldwide, we're focused on advancing the world of health while creating opportunities for our people to grow, develop and make a meaningful impact.  In this role, that impact stretches across APAC.  You'll work within a region of diverse and dynamic markets, partnering with teams across different healthcare systems, commercial environments and levels of market maturity. That complexity is precisely what makes the opportunity so interesting.  Rather than simply inheriting an established way of working, you'll have the opportunity to help shape best practice, strengthen our regional approach and influence how we make commercially smarter pricing decisions.  Because at BD, possibility isn't just imagined. It's made.  What's in It for You?    Ready to Make an Impact?  If you're the kind of analyst who doesn't stop at"what happened?" and instinctively asks"why, and what should we do next?", we'd love to hear from you.  Bring your analytical capability, commercial curiosity and strategic thinking to BD and help shape smarter pricing decisions across APAC    Why Join Us?  To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.  We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.  https://bd.com/careers. Title: Workforce Planning Data Specialist
Description: Senior Specialist, Workforce Planning CIMIC Group is looking for a workforce planning specialist who enjoys solving complex workforce challenges and turning data into meaningful business decisions. This newly created role sits within our Talent team and will play a key role in helping the business understand future workforce requirements across major projects, tenders and growth opportunities. You'll work with leaders across the Group to forecast workforce demand, identify capability gaps, provide market intelligence and deliver insights that influence workforce and talent strategy. This is an opportunity to step into a highly visible role where you'll partner with senior stakeholders and have a direct impact on how one of Australia's largest infrastructure and engineering groups plans for future growth. What you'll be doing - Leading workforce forecasting and supply and demand analysis across projects and business units. - Developing workforce planning models, scenarios and insights to support business decisions. - Building dashboards and reporting that provide visibility of workforce risks, capability gaps and future hiring requirements. - Providing labour market intelligence, talent mapping and workforce benchmarking. - Partnering with Talent Acquisition teams to convert workforce forecasts into recruitment strategies. - Working closely with operational, project, finance and executive stakeholders to support workforce planning outcomes. - Driving improvements in workforce analytics, reporting, automation and data quality. - Contributing to the ongoing development of workforce planning frameworks, methodologies and best practice across the Group.   What we're looking for You'll likely come from a workforce planning, workforce analytics, talent intelligence, people analytics or strategic planning background and be comfortable working with large data sets to tell a compelling story. You'll bring: - Experience in workforce analytics, workforce planning or a similar analytical role. - Strong capability in forecasting, modelling and scenario planning. - Advanced Power BI reporting and data visualisation skills. - The ability to translate complex data into practical business insights. - Strong stakeholder engagement skills and confidence working with senior leaders. - A commercial mindset and an interest in linking workforce outcomes to business performance. - Experience working across multiple stakeholders, projects or business units/lines of business.   Why join us? This role offers the opportunity to work on some of the most significant infrastructure, engineering and resources projects in the region while helping shape the future workforce capability of the broader CIMIC Group. You'll be part of a highly collaborative team, working on projects that combine workforce strategy, analytics, talent intelligence and business planning, with the scope to influence decisions at both an operational and executive level.

Title: Senior / Lead Analytics Engineer
Description: We're looking for a Senior or Lead Analytics Engineer to help Insight Timer learn from its data. Insight Timer is the world's largest meditation and wellness community, with over 30 million users. You'll work closely with product, engineering and company leaders, turning their questions into experiments, data models and insights that help people live better.  This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll measure and interpret the experiments that decide what we ship. You'll build the data models and metrics the whole company relies on, and you'll use good software engineering practices to keep our data clean, trusted and easy to use. A product mindset matters here. You're building insight that improves the app over a user's whole lifetime, not just answering one-off questions.  You'll also help lead. As one of the most senior people in analytics, you'll set the technical bar, mentor other analytics engineers, and help us move toward more self-serve and agentic analytics, where teams can answer their own questions and the platform does more of the work.  We like to move fast and do work that matters. You'll be trusted to make important calls and to balance speed with rigour. If you enjoy building systems that are both scalable and genuinely useful to millions of people, we'd love to talk.    Imagine a platform which could amplify something as simple as your attendance into deep transformational shifts for humanity. A place where showing up was enough. Where each individual visit combined with millions more to trigger huge waves of health and happiness around the world. What would such a platform look like? Could you even build it? And more importantly, how would you protect it from becoming another Instagram, TikTok or Twitter which magnify the very worst of us.  If we can answer these questions, we believe Insight Timer's community will emerge as one of the most important companies of the 21st century. A place, not a product, which is capable of reversing the modern day health pandemic by harmonising the human spirit before problems arise. And if we get there, well, the opportunities are endless. Imagine a modern-day renaissance where health, belonging and purpose become the new definitions of happiness for hundreds of millions of people around the world, including you.  And all you need to do is show up.

Title: Senior / Lead Analytics Engineer
Description: We're looking for a Senior or Lead Analytics Engineer to help Insight Timer learn from its data. Insight Timer is the world's largest meditation and wellness community, with over 30 million users. You'll work closely with product, engineering and company leaders, turning their questions into experiments, data models and insights that help people live better.  This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll measure and interpret the experiments that decide what we ship. You'll build the data models and metrics the whole company relies on, and you'll use good software engineering practices to keep our data clean, trusted and easy to use. A product mindset matters here. You're building insight that improves the app over a user's whole lifetime, not just answering one-off questions.  You'll also help lead. As one of the most senior people in analytics, you'll set the technical bar, mentor other analytics engineers, and help us move toward more self-serve and agentic analytics, where teams can answer their own questions and the platform does more of the work.  We like to move fast and do work that matters. You'll be trusted to make important calls and to balance speed with rigour. If you enjoy building systems that are both scalable and genuinely useful to millions of people, we'd love to talk.    Imagine a platform which could amplify something as simple as your attendance into deep transformational shifts for humanity. A place where showing up was enough. Where each individual visit combined with millions more to trigger huge waves of health and happiness around the world. What would such a platform look like? Could you even build it? And more importantly, how would you protect it from becoming another Instagram, TikTok or Twitter which magnify the very worst of us.  If we can answer these questions, we believe Insight Timer's community will emerge as one of the most important companies of the 21st century. A place, not a product, which is capable of reversing the modern day health pandemic by harmonising the human spirit before problems arise. And if we get there, well, the opportunities are endless. Imagine a modern-day renaissance where health, belonging and purpose become the new definitions of happiness for hundreds of millions of people around the world, including you.  And all you need to do is show up.

Title: Senior Consultant, Data Analytics, Healthcare
Description: Who We Are  FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.  At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.  Are you ready to make your impact?  About The Role  At FTI Consulting, we are dedicated to transforming our clients operations and uplifting business outcomes through delivery of Data Analytics & AI driven solutions. As a specialised consulting firm, we offer a unique environment that combines the agility of a small firm with the depth of industry expertise you’d expect from larger consultancies.  In this position, you will have the opportunity to work and learn alongside our team of experts, developing your problem-solving abilities in parallel to your technical skills. You will develop in-depth knowledge of our clients' objectives and challenges to design and develop advanced analytics solutions to guide their decision making and preparing them for the future.  What You'll Do  Design and deliver end-to-end analytics solutions, from problem framing and data acquisition through to modelling, insight generation, and executive-level storytelling for clients across multiple industries.  Support the development of cloud platforms using AWS and Azure  Identifying, acquiring, synthesising, and analysing relevant data, understanding the relationships among multiple sources and types of data, and organising this information to facilitate effective data analysis  Develop robust data pipelines (you may use tools such as SQL, Alteryx, Python, DataBricks, Data Factory. Redshift etc).  Apply machine learning or statistical methods (regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, NLP etc) to real business problems  Developing advanced analytics and complex system models, e.g. discrete event, agent based, systems dynamics or optimization (using tools such as AnyLogic)  Understanding of how to make best use of LLMs and generative AI in a business context for clients and your own work  Develop dashboards that generate measurable business value and are built to last beyond the engagement.  Partner closely with client stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, translating complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations.  Contribute to business development by supporting proposals, thought leadership, and the growth of the firm's analytics capabilities.  How You’ll Grow  We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.  As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.  What You Will Need to Succeed  As this role works with the Federal Government, we require all candidates to have Australian Citizenship.  Ideally, you have 8 months – 4 years of prior consulting experience or you are a high performer looking to move from industry or government to consulting. You may have experience in health, mining or retail, in areas including procurement, logistics and supply chain, operations or a strong desire to work in these sectors. We are looking for someone with a mix of the attributes listed below:  You are highly motivated with strong work ethic, enjoy solving complex problems with data, and eager to learn and grow your skills in this area.  Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and persuasively to non-technical audiences  Ability to travel within the country (where practical and possible).  Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, multi-task environment with a strong attention to detail.  Experience working in project environments and flexibility with respect to assigned tasks and engagements required due to challenging deadlines, changing deliverables and evolving task priorities.  Ability to interface with team members and client personnel in demanding, deadline-driven situations  In terms of technical skills and experience, we are seeking candidates with a mix of capabilities and specialised expertise across the following areas, recognising that candidates are not expected to have experience in all areas.  Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline (mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, physics, chemistry, analytics etc.)  Proficiency using Python, R, SQL or Alteryx for data manipulation, cleansing and data modelling  Experience using visualisation tools such as Power BI and Tableau  Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks)  Understanding and experience applying AI tools, machine learning and LLMs to solve problems  Experience developing simulation or optimization models of complex systems (desired, not required)        Minimum Pay: $95,000  Maximum Pay: $130,000

Title: Fleet Officer
Description: PP0004 Fleet Officer  Turn data, financial insight and good coordination into practical fleet solutions.  As our Fleet Officer, you'll play an important role in supporting Council's Light Fleet program, combining analysis, financial planning and day-to-day coordination to help us make informed fleet decisions.  This is not a role that requires you to arrive as a fleet technical specialist. We're looking for someone who can work confidently with data, numbers, systems and people. Fleet-specific technical knowledge can be developed on the job.    This is a varied role that balances focused analytical work with practical coordination across Council and with external suppliers.  You'll analyse fleet and financial information, prepare reports and recommendations, support vehicle replacement and budget planning, and coordinate activities such as vehicle purchases, disposals and fit-outs.  You'll also spend time working with suppliers and vehicle body builders to discuss specifications and equipment fit-outs, and collaborate with Finance and operational teams to keep fleet activities moving.  Because fleet activities connect across a number of Council processes, you'll need to be organised, comfortable managing competing priorities and willing to support the broader team when workloads change.          You'll bring experience in fleet administration, asset management, finance, procurement, data analysis or a related field, ideally developed over three to five years in a similar environment.      Experience with Power BI, Power Automate and SharePoint would be highly regarded.    We’re open to candidates from a range of professional backgrounds. Fleet-specific knowledge can be developed, while strong skills in analysis, finance, procurement, asset management or business provide an excellent foundation for the role.  A Certificate III in Business would also be relevant.    Mackay Regional Council is a dynamic, progressive and financially sound local government. Title: Senior Analytics Engineer
Description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!  Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.  We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.  It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.    Kraken Distribution is building a native analytics capability to support our products, customer migrations and growing customer base. As our first Senior Analytics Engineer in Distribution, you will establish the data models, datasets and working practices that allow our teams and customers to generate trusted insights from Kraken data.  You will be embedded within the Distribution team and work closely with Product, Engineering and Client Delivery Leads to understand customer needs and translate them into scalable analytics capabilities. You will report through the Distribution organisation, with a dotted-line relationship into Kraken’s central Analytics and Data Platform teams. This structure ensures that Distribution priorities drive your work while keeping you connected to Kraken’s wider data community, standards and technical direction.    This is a senior, hands-on role with significant scope to shape how analytics is delivered across Kraken Distribution. You will develop a deep understanding of the global Kraken application data model and the Distribution domain, build curated data models and lightweight ingestion pipelines, and create the documentation and foundations required to support future reporting, analytics and advanced insights.  Kraken Analytics will provide alignment on modelling standards and analytics architecture, while Data Platform will continue to own the foundational platform and shared data infrastructure. You will own Distribution-specific analytics models, datasets, ingestion workflows and data products, working closely with both teams to reuse and extend Kraken’s shared capabilities.      We are looking for a senior analytics engineer who combines strong technical judgement with the ability to operate autonomously in a complex, customer-facing environment.  You will be comfortable turning ambiguous business and domain problems into well-designed, reliable data products. You can move between detailed, hands-on engineering work and higher-level conversations about customer needs, architecture and priorities. You are also able to influence stakeholders and establish effective ways of working without relying on formal authority.  As the first person in this role, you will be motivated by the opportunity to create something new, while recognising when to reuse and build upon the standards, tools and expertise that already exist across Kraken.
